content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and 1 for Project Technical Support II (Field Work).

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. PhD in microbiology will be given preference. For Project Technical support II (Field work): 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) + Five Years' Experience in relevant subject / field OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/ field + two years' experience in relevant subject.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age: 35 years Age relaxation will be as per Govt. rules. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 18-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is 18 August 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been released for various posts, including Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical support - II (Field work), under AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with all required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and other posts in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What are the qualifications required for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), candidates need a Post Graduate Degree, including integrated PG degrees. A PhD in microbiology will be given preference for this position.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Technical support - II (Field work) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Project Technical support - II (Field work) post is Rs. 20000 + 20% HRA per month. This is a contractual position at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the walk-in date for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in/reporting date for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026. Candidates who are shortlisted after the email application process may be called for a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job location for the posts under AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 will be Jodhpur, Rajasthan. The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is located at Pincode 342005.
